claim: F2: Explicit recovery_members: missing canonical member bars or invalid closes (NULL, NaN, +/-infinity, zero, negative), including outside-sector bars consumed by market counts, must refuse before changing any of four derived tables. Frozen denominator keeps proven nontrading identities. Default daily behavior, other fields and concurrency are out of scope.
verified_subclaims: Missing canonical member bar (declared/projected member M2 absent from fact_stock_daily) raises ValueError before any write; all four derived tables byte-identical to pre-call full-row snapshot (test_missing_member_bar_refuses_untouched PASSED)
Invalid canonical close NULL on an outside-sector bar consumed by market counts refuses before any write (param None PASSED)
Invalid canonical close NaN refuses before any write (param nan PASSED)
Invalid canonical close +infinity refuses before any write (param inf PASSED)
Invalid canonical close zero refuses before any write (param 0.0 PASSED)
Invalid canonical close negative (-1.0) refuses before any write (param -1.0 PASSED)
Outside-sector bars are inside the invalid-close scan: OUT is not a declared/projected member yet its bad bar triggers refusal, satisfying 'including outside-sector bars consumed by market counts'

Refusal happens before changing any of the four derived tables: probe seeds one local:seed row per table and asserts full-row (SELECT * ORDER BY ALL) equality after refusal, which also detects cross-date deletion and value mutation, not just count changes

Frozen denominator keeps proven nontrading identities: with M2 declared nontrading, no bar and no projection, run writes with ratio_denominator=2, observed_count=1, nontrading_codes=['600002.SH'] (test_control_frozen_denominator_keeps_nontrading PASSED)
Valid control path writes with denominator_basis='frozen_identity', market_limit_up=1, recovery_member_coverage ratio_denominator=2 (test_control_frozen_denominator_writes PASSED)
Nontrading identity that actually has a live bar refuses (synthetic suspension guard) with tables untouched (test_nontrading_identity_with_bar_refuses PASSED)
not_verified_subclaims: Invalid close = -infinity: claim enumerates '+/-infinity' but the probe parametrizes only +inf ([None, -1.0, 0.0, nan, inf]); math.isfinite() would reject -inf on the same code line, but this was never executed and per protocol unexecuted behavior is not_verified
Invalid close on a declared/projected member bar specifically: executed only via an outside-sector bar; the identical scan line covers members, but no member-bar-invalid-close case was run
Deep content correctness of rows written on the success path (heat/detail/ladder/leader row values beyond counters and result-dict fields)
Default daily behavior unchanged (recovery_members=None path), other fields (e.g. NaN amount, pre_close<=0), force=True, and concurrency: explicitly out of claim scope and not probed
Missing bars for identities neither declared nor projected: undetectable by design (no identity listing); claim scope is 'member bars' only
